scope.profile: Bounded initialized owned arrays in 2D/3D; two-object global refresh, repeated/growing/shrinking/zero user widths, metadata reset, partial reads and physical allocation tails.

behavior: NDTMP 2D mixed header parses row count/default/selector. Selector 2 reads a temporary pair array and copies second value to temperature and second-minus-first to gradient even after partial row failure. Other selectors use scalar fallback; 3D uses the ordinary real-column reader.

USRNOD/USRELM width changes resize opaque 64-byte metadata records, preserve existing records and zero new records, then refresh all objects. Equal widths are no-ops. USRELM selector 0 substitutes 2; node width 0 clears. Each default scalar and final row reader invokes the selected getter, preserving shape history.

MATAXI sets dimension-dependent width before selected allocation, then mode 2 mutates root width without resizing the allocated descriptor. Physical tails and root/descriptor width divergence are retained.
NWEAR sets width 5 and selects its allocation; null storage skips payload. DRMESH consumes payload only in 3D.
Property guard 1d2b70 returns 1 on both native paths, so the observed selected-getter property cleanup branch remains inactive.
test_order: All 38 existing CTests passed before candidate freeze; both newly registered replay tests passed on the same unchanged candidate. This is not a claim of a single 40-test invocation.

checker_corrections.candidate_comparator: Training checker initially required a serial for a single property-guard event; corrected event pairing, retained guard check, archived diagnostic. Held-out passed unchanged checker. No C++ changes.
checker_corrections.independent_audit: Corrected constructor-versus-refresh component defaults and explicitly classified native row-buffer EOF leaks from source and training observations. Held-out passed unchanged verifier; 38 applied corruption checks per cohort.
checker_corrections.input_manifest: Two late audit bindings briefly changed the training manifest after freeze. Original bytes were restored before capture; probe and fixtures never changed. Restoration and all hashes are retained.

native_resource_observation.description: Both runs observe an unfreed 16-byte implicit-reader row buffer on scalar EOF at 4199f0. The outer paired temperature temporary is freed. C++ uses RAII; heap leakage is not reproduced. Values, statuses, stream cursors and persistent state remain compatibility requirements.

limitations: Finite ASCII/finite numeric owned-storage profile; no claim of full application equivalence.
Metadata records remain opaque 64-byte values; named property editing, custom CUSVAR/DYNARY stores and their ownership are unresolved.
Negative widths, unsafe mode 2 capacity growth, allocation failure, undefined locals, uninitialized direct-buffer tails and externally shared storage remain outside this profile.
Native pointer identities are checked within original lifetimes; replacement addresses and native heap leakage are not ABI requirements.
DVOLF/TICF positive root13f4 width producer, remaining material properties, full DB state import/export, scientific operations and console integration remain required work.
next_action: Recover CUSVAR198/DYNARY266 backing storage and lifecycle from REA before choosing a C++ representation; continue remaining width producers, properties and complete application workflows.
